summary: Due to a power failure, Wacky Wheels Jackson was dark from Friday Mar 26 (2027-03-26) through Tuesday Mar 30 (2027-03-30). To resolve the outage, 9 production orders were moved, including 6 rescheduled at the same plant and 3 transferred to other plants because no same-plant slot was free. Furthermore, 36 dealers were notified once each for 79 customer orders, and 17 loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: The system acted on the confirmed incident because IDs and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the auditor verified compliance with all rescheduling, dealer notification, and loaner allocation rules. Additionally, the pre-flight check on an enterprise sandbox copy passed and the live environment matched the planning baseline prior to writing, verified by 6 slot reads and 13 pool reads.
